name: Heinrich Kemmler
canonNotes: The Lichemaster, a Necromancer whose mind was shattered and remade by his hatred and dark studies, bound to the wight-king Krell.
Dreams of vengeance upon the living and of mastery over death.
voiceNotes: Bitter, rasping and obsessed; flits between cold reason and madness.
Contemptuous of the living, especially priests and Dwarfs.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
